title: Having Reviewed the Evidence
gist_ar: ملخص تنفيذي متخصص: خلاصة مراجعة لبرنامج تدريب، بأسلوب مكثّف ورسمي.
text:
Having considered the submissions of all four departments, and taking into
account the pilot data gathered between March and September, the review reaches
three conclusions.

First, and being aware that this contradicts the interim report, the programme
does not reduce processing time. Measured across 1,400 cases, the mean fell by
under two per cent, a figure well within normal variation. Faced with this, the
department has argued that the benefit is qualitative. That may be so, but it was
not what was funded.

Second, the programme does streamline handover. Cases transferred between
officers now carry a single concise summary rather than the previous file note,
and errors at handover fell by thirty-one per cent. Given that handover errors
were the original justification for the funding, this is the finding that should
have led the interim report, and did not.

Third, and in light of the above, the underlying design assumption requires
revision. The programme was intended to save time by improving quality, thereby
recovering its cost within a year. Compared with that projection, it has improved
quality without saving time, and is thus better understood as a risk-reduction
measure. Assessed on that basis it performs well; assessed on the basis it was
approved on, it does not.

Accordingly, and notwithstanding the department's preference for a further pilot,
this review recommends that the programme be continued, with a view to
re-approval under a corrected business case, and that the interim report be
formally withdrawn. Having said that, no reader should conclude that the
programme failed. It succeeded at something nobody asked it to do, which is a
governance problem, not a design one.

questions.q: What is the review's finding on processing time?
questions.q_ar: إيه نتيجة المراجعة بخصوص وقت المعالجة؟
options: It fell substantially, comfortably exceeding the projection in the interim report
It fell by under two per cent, within normal variation

questions.q: Which finding does the writer say should have led the interim report?
questions.q_ar: أنهي نتيجة كان لازم التقرير المؤقت يبدأ بيها؟
options: The qualitative benefit the department fell back on once the time finding had collapsed
The need for a further pilot
The thirty-one per cent fall in handover errors

questions.q: How should the programme now be understood?
options: As a risk-reduction measure rather than a time-saving one

questions.q: What does the writer mean by 'a governance problem, not a design one'?
questions.q_ar: إيه معنى 'مشكلة إدارة، مش مشكلة تصميم'؟
options: The programme worked, but was approved against the wrong objective
